body: A songwriter as prolific, long-lived and legendary as Jimmy Webb is bound to have left a few things behind over the decades. title: ‘Projects Like This Haven’t Been Done in Bluegrass’: Lindsay Lou Leads All-Star New Album Celebrating the Women Songwriters Who Shaped the Genre
summary: Alongside Lou, the album features more bluegrass luminaries including Alison Brown, Molly Tuttle and Sierra Hull.
body: Vocalist and guitarist Lindsay Lou had played songs such as Ricky Skaggs’ “All I Ever Loved Was You” and Ralph Stanley’s “I Only Exist” in bluegrass jam sessions for years, before realizing that some of the songs so closely associated with the bluegrass canon’s most popular trailblazing male artists were actually written by women. “You’ll hear these songs in almost every jam, so to find out they were written by women felt like this beautiful piece of encouragement, to find out that all along there have been women’s voices in this music, and they are pinned to some of the most-jammed songs, like ‘I Only Exist,’ ‘High on a Mountain,’ and ‘Freight Train.’” Lou’s new album, Bluegrass Women , out Friday (Aug. 14) on Work of Bart Records/Soundly Music, aims to balance the scales, placing a long-overdue spotlight on an older generation of women bluegrass songwriters whose musical creations have been often overlooked. Lou co-produced the album with Shani Gandhi. body: Uber-prolific Australian band King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard has released nearly 30 albums since its 2012 debut — in other words, the band isn’t known for the drawn-out studio perfectionism that often stymies musicians. But with Alien Metal , its 28th studio album — and first in 14 months, an eternity in the Gizzverse – King Gizzard did something out of character: It took its time. And with good reason. Out today (Aug. 14), Alien Metal is arguably the biggest swing in a catalog full of them , as the sextet best known for wild, garage-meets-psych-rock ditched its guitars in favor of a hulking Eurorack, a type of modular synthesizer developed in the ’90s that all of its members could play simultaneously. title: This Good Lock module is wreaking havoc on your Galaxy phone’s home screen, but a fix is on the way
summary: Samsung says the DIY Home feature in Home Up is to blame for this bug.
body: TL;DR A new bug affecting the Samsung Home Up module is causing home screen folders and widgets to lose their position. Samsung says the bug is related to the DIY Home feature and confirms a fix is on the way. Another Home Up bug reported this week caused home screen folders to spill over to the next page. Samsung’s Good Lock suite unlocks a wide range of customization options for your Galaxy device. Among the more popular Good Lock modules is Home Up, which offers extensive control over the stock One UI launcher’s appearance and functionality. It now seems there’s a bug affecting this particular module. In a complaint on the Samsung community forum , a user reports that their home screen’s folders and widgets are “pushed off the display” when accessing the inner screen of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 . One can imagine how frustrating a glitch like this can be, especially for users who like folders and widgets to be placed in a specific area of the home screen.

title: PS3 emulation on Android keeps getting better with new ARMSX3 updates
summary: Expect support for package files and folder-based games, as well as a host of fixes.
body: Credit: Hadlee Simons / Android Authority TL;DR The team behind the ARMSX3 emulator for Android has released a stream of updates in recent days. These updates add features like support for folder-based games, save state support, and a new default audio backend. These updates also bring a variety of fixes and performance improvements. ARMSX3 was released last week as the third PS3 emulator for Android. However, we were particularly excited about this release as the development team has a reputation for blazing-fast updates, as evident by ARMSX2 . There’s good news if you want ARMSX3 to have a similar streak of updates. The ARMSX3 team has already issued a stream of updates on GitHub since the initial releases last week. These updates include support for folder-based games, PKG game files with RAP licenses, trophies, ANGLE wrapper functionality, and functional save states. We also get improvements like shader caches being removed when uninstalling a game, pause functionality actually working, and more reliable firmware installation on slower devices.

title: برشلونة يرد.. هل يكون لويس سواريز بديلا لصفقة ألفاريز؟

body: الوقت ينفد علق نادي برشلونة على الأنباء التي ربطته بضم لويس سواريز، مهاجم سبورتنج لشبونة، كخيار بديل في حال عدم نجاح محاولاته لضم الأرجنتيني خوليان ألفاريز، مهاجم أتلتيكو مدريد. يذكر أن الصحفي المتخصص في سوق الانتقالات فابريزيو رومانو من أكد أن لويس سواريز ، البالغ من العمر 28 عامًا على طاولة برشلونة كأحد البدائل المطروحة، حال عدم تطور محاولة التعاقد مع ألفاريز بشكل إيجابي. لكن نفت مصادر من النادي الكتالوني لصحيفة "موندو ديبورتيفو" الإسبانية ، هذه الأنباء بشكل قاطع بعد فترة قصيرة، مؤكدة أن رهان البارسا ينصب على المهاجم الأرجنتيني في أتلتيكو مدريد، وهو أمر معروف على نطاق واسع. ويواصل المهاجم الأرجنتيني محاولاته من أجل الضغط لإتمام انتقاله إلى برشلونة، كما يحافظ النادي الكتالوني على اهتمامه بالتعاقد معه، باعتباره الخطة الأولى الواضحة لدى هانز فليك وديكو. ويتعين على برشلونة، في حال تعثر محاولته للتعاقد مع المهاجم الأرجنتيني، تفعيل البدائل، إذ لن يتمكن النادي من الانتظار إلى أجل غير مسمى، لكن البارسا يؤكد أن لويس سواريز ليس أحد هذه الخيارات.

title: The Pixel 11 Pro is a slap in the face to Android enthusiasts everywhere
summary: Enthusiasts are being left behind.
body: The Pixel 11 announcement felt like watching a car crash in slow motion. For months, we’ve heard rumors of Google price hikes, but I hoped that would be the only significant change. We already witnessed Samsung raise prices on some models, but with decent upgrades. Motorola kept the specs relatively unchanged but raised the price. Unfortunately, Google opted for the worst of both worlds, raising prices while giving buyers a RAM downgrade. The battle for the soul of Pixels was lost by enthusiasts years ago, but they refuse to leave the field. It’s why there is always so much noise surrounding the devices. body: Life’s a party when you’re living in paradise . Good things and long waits, well, they’re fused at the hip. Paradise arrives with an array of guest talent, from Killer Mike, Rico Nasty, Phantogram, to Aussie singer and songwriter Matt Corby, and is three years in the making. At the top of the 14-song collection, the familiar voice of Jack Thompson, the legendary actor and activist who led a slew of classic films in the ‘70s and ‘80s and presented to the world one of the enduring images of the hard-partying, and equally progressive, Australian bloke. body: سافر رودري، نجم مانشستر سيتي، مساء الخميس، من مدريد إلى ليفربول، على متن رحلة جوية عادية تابعة لشركة رايان إير.  وذكرت صحيفة ماركا ، أن رودري سينضم اليوم الجمعة، إلى تدريبات مانشستر سيتي، بعدما لم يتم حسم انتقاله إلى برشلونة حتى الآن.  وسينتظر رودري، حل الصفقة قبل العودة إلى إسبانيا خلال الأيام المقبلة، وحتى هذه اللحظة، لم يتوصل برشلونة ومانشستر سيتي إلى اتفاق بشأن الصفقة. والتقطت كاميرات Jijantes لحظة وصول اللاعب إلى ليفربول، المدينة التي تبعد نحو 50 كيلو مترًا عن مانشستر.  ولم يدلِ رودري، الذي قضى جزءًا كبيرًا من عطلته في إسبانيا بعد تتويجه بكأس العالم، بأي تصريحات بعد وصوله لإنجلترا. ويرغب برشلونة في حسم صفقة رودري في أسرع وقت ممكن، لكن مانشستر سيتي يسعى أيضًا لتحقيق أكبر استفادة مالية ممكنة من العملية. وعلى الرغم من أن مواقف الطرفين بدأت تقترب، فإنهما لم يصلا بعد إلى نقطة اتفاق نهائي. ويرغب النادي الإنجليزي في الحصول على نحو 70 مليون يورو ثابتة، بينما وصل عرض برشلونة الأخير إلى 65 مليون يورو، شاملة المتغيرات.

title: Camera Looks may finally fix the biggest sin of Google Pixel cameras
summary: Camera Looks brings fully customizable, film-like simulations to the Pixel 11 series.
body: For years, Google Pixel phones have earned a reputation for being incredible point-and-shoot cameras. Sure, if you want to get down and dirty with prosumer features, Chinese OEMs have everyone else beat. But out of the box, it’s hard to argue that the Pixel makes it absurdly simple to get great shots, albeit with a caveat. Google, by the very nature of its approach to imaging, has leaned hard into an aggressive HDR implementation. This can often mean flat-looking images with artificially lifted shadows and details that are just a bit too sharp for my liking.

title: Google Meet can now take notes even for in-person meetings, here’s how
summary: Google Meet can now capture face-to-face conversations and turn them into useful notes.
body: TL;DR Google Meet’s Take notes for me feature now works for in-person meetings. It creates a transcript, summary, and action items in a Google Doc after the session. The feature is rolling out to eligible Google AI and Workspace plans on Android, web, and iOS. We’ve seen speech recognition evolve rapidly over the past year. Voice typing is so accurate now that dictation is replacing traditional keyboards for some of us, with specialized software like Wispr Flow making it effortless to catch every word. Some brands have even turned to dedicated physical hardware to capture offline discussions. Now, Google wants a piece of that offline pie, and it doesn’t require buying extra gadgets. Google officially announced that its Take notes for me feature in Google Meet, previously locked to virtual calls, now supports face-to-face, in-person meetings (via 9to5Google ). Instead of serving purely as a video conferencing tool, Google is morphing Meet into a central hub for all your professional conversations, online or off. Google first previewed the move at Cloud Next in April, and the feature is now beginning its wider rollout.

title: Gemini wants to turn your boring spreadsheets into interactive ones

body: TL;DR Google Sheets is rolling out a new Canvas feature that uses Gemini to turn boring spreadsheets into interactive ones. Using the feature requires no prior coding or formula knowledge. Your canvas stays synced with the original Sheet, while letting you customize its layout, design, and functionality. Google’s new flipped Sheets icon is also visible in the Canvas announcement images and GIFs. What started out as a relatively simple spreadsheet web application 20 years ago has since transformed into one of the most used productivity tools out there. We’re talking about Google Sheets , which is now a lot more than just rows, columns, and formulas, and thanks to Gemini’s smarts , it’s about to become a lot more versatile. The tech giant is rolling out a new Gemini-powered feature that can turn your Google Sheets spreadsheets into “custom, interactive mini-apps.” It’s called Sheets canvas, and it’s designed to help you turn raw data into something easier to interact with.

title: PSA: Don’t trust that Chrome update popup — it could be malware
summary: A suspicious extension appears to be triggering convincing fake browser update warnings.
body: TL;DR Persistent pop-ups urging you to update Chrome may actually be malware pushed by compromised browser extensions. The issue affects Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Brave, and Opera, attempting to trick users into running potentially malicious scripts. Identifying and removing suspicious or newly acquired extensions is currently the primary way to stop the pop-ups. We all have our favorite Chrome extensions that make daily web browsing effortless, whether it’s a quick screen snip tool, a right-click unlocker, or a simple tab manager. But what happens when one of those trusty add-ons quietly turns against you? Over the past few days, an increasing number of web users have fallen victim to a frustratingly convincing browser scam that tricks people into downloading harmful malware disguised as routine system updates. The issue manifests as an aggressive pop-up claiming a “Critical Update Required” or “Update available” to keep using your browser. If you click to proceed, instead of a standard browser update, it downloads a suspicious .vbs or .exe script directly to your machine.

body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority Scouring the new Pixel 11 series for significant hardware changes this year, the biggest standout is the Tensor G6’s new and improved Tensor Processing Unit (TPU). Google says the Tensor G6’s TPU delivers 50% more compute power and up to 3.5x faster performance in some workloads. Impressive numbers, sure — but what does that actually mean when you pick up a Pixel 11? For starters, let’s get to grips with what the TPU actually does. While Tensor’s CPU handles your apps and its GPU mostly handles games, the TPU is primarily tasked with number-crunching for machine learning workloads, featuring dedicated dot-product matrix math units and high-speed memory access. In other words, it’s the main AI processor inside Google’s Pixel handsets. It’s used for a wide variety of on-device tasks that don’t require the cloud, such as speech recognition, voice transcription, and text suggestions.
